note: Written by Claude, NOT real exam questions. Optional extras only (mcq-written.js).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: A galaxy is 150 Mpc from Earth. The Hubble constant is 70 km s^−1 Mpc^−1. What is the recession speed of the galaxy in km s^−1?
questions.rule: number options: one real slip each, smallest to largest, same unit

wrong.A: divided the distance by H0 instead of multiplying
wrong.C: converted km to m but kept the unit km s^−1
wrong.D: converted Mpc to pc before multiplying

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: The peak wavelength of light from star X is 480 nm. Star Y has half the surface temperature of star X. What is the peak wavelength of light from star Y?
questions.rule: number options: one real slip each (Wien: λ ∝ 1/T)

wrong.A: thought λmax is proportional to T
wrong.B: thought λmax depends only on the element, not temperature

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Two stars have the same radius. Star P has twice the surface temperature of star Q. What is the luminosity of P divided by the luminosity of Q?
questions.rule: number options: wrong powers of T (Stefan: L ∝ r^2 T^4)

wrong.A: thought L is proportional to T
wrong.B: squared T (confused with the r^2 term)

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Which observation is evidence that the Universe was once very hot and dense?
options: the absorption lines in the Sun's spectrum
the parallax of nearby stars over one year
the luminosity of main sequence stars
questions.rule: word options: parallel wording, similar lengths, each a real but wrong piece of astrophysics evidence

wrong.B: spectral lines show what a star is made of, not the Universe's past

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: A car of mass 1200 kg moves at 10 m/s. What is its kinetic energy?
questions.rule: number options: forgot to square v, forgot the ½, smallest to largest

wrong.B: did not square the speed and left out the ½

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: A kettle transfers 180 000 J of energy in 60 s. What is the power of the kettle?
questions.rule: number options: power of ten, forgot to divide, multiplied instead

wrong.C: forgot to divide by the time
wrong.D: multiplied by the time instead of dividing

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: A spring is stretched. Which energy store of the spring increases?
questions.rule: word options: one-word near miss (elastic / gravitational potential)

wrong.B: mixed up the two potential stores
wrong.C: thought stretching mainly heats the spring
wrong.D: thought anything that moves gains kinetic energy at the end

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Which quantity is the energy needed to raise the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1 °C?
questions.rule: word options: near miss (specific latent heat), related quantities

wrong.A: confused raising temperature with changing state
wrong.B: confused how fast energy flows with how much is needed
wrong.C: picked the general term for stored particle energy
